author: nickyeow

english.text: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.

jyutping: ngo5 giu3 aa3 maa1 sei3 dim2 aai3 ngo5 hei2 san1。
text: 我叫阿媽四點嗌我起身。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Look at that building. Is it a temple?

jyutping: tai2 haa2 go2 zo6 gin3 zuk1 mat6。hai6 mai6 miu6 lai4 gaa3？
text: 睇吓嗰座建築物。係咪廟嚟㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You are always complaining about your husband.
You're always complaining about your husband.

jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 waa6 nei5 go3 lou5 gung1 ne1 joeng2 m4 hou2 go2 joeng2 m4 hou2。
text: 你成日都喺度話你個老公呢樣唔好嗰樣唔好。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've lost interest in golf.

jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 go1 ji5 fu1 kau4 ji5 ging1 mou5 saai3 hing3 ceoi3 laa3。
text: 我對哥爾夫球已經冇晒興趣喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sunday is the day when I am busiest.

jyutping: sing1 kei4 jat6 hai6 ngo5 hai2 jat1 go3 lai5 baai3 jap6 min6 zeoi3 mong4 ge3 jat1 jat6。
text: 星期日係我喺一個禮拜入面最忙嘅一日。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Does she play the piano?
Does she play piano?

jyutping: keoi5 sik1 m4 sik1 daan6 gong3 kam4 gaa3？
text: 佢識唔識彈鋼琴㗎？

author: fercheung

english.text: I can't find Tim.

jyutping: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou2 aa3 Tim wo3。
text: 我搵唔到阿Tim喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How difficult is that?

jyutping: jau5 gei2 naan4 aa3？
text: 有幾難呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you don't have enough evidence to convince the other person you're right, make stuff up.

jyutping: mou5 zuk1 gau3 zing3 geoi3 zing3 ming4 zi6 gei2 hai2 ngaam1，mai6 lou5 ceoi1 di1 je5 ceot1 lai4 lo1。
text: 冇足夠證據證明自己喺啱，咪老吹啲嘢出嚟囉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Sami doesn't want to be on TV.

jyutping: sam1 mei5 m4 soeng2 soeng5 din6 si6。
text: 森美唔想上電視。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Turn the TV off. You're not even watching it.

jyutping: sik1 zo2 bou6 din6 si6 keoi5 laa1，nei5 dou1 m4 hai6 tai2 gan2 ge3。
text: 熄咗部電視佢啦，你都唔係睇緊嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did you get the letter I sent you?

jyutping: ngo5 gei3 bei2 nei5 fung1 seon3 nei5 sau1 dou2 mei6 aa3？
text: 我寄俾你封信你收到未呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: We have to do something about this.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 jiu3 gaau2 gaau2 keoi5。
text: 我哋真係要搞搞佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Would you please tell me your full name and address?

jyutping: cing2 man6 nei5 cyun4 meng2 tung4 dei6 zi2 hai6 me1 aa3？
text: 請問你全名同地址係咩呀？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: If you prick us, do we not bleed?

jyutping: nei5 gat1 ngo5 dang2，m4 tung1 ngo5 dang2 m4 lau4 hyut3 me1？
text: 你㓤我等，唔通我等唔流血咩？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: We got tired of walking.

jyutping: ngo5 dang2 haang4 dou3 gui6。
text: 我等行到攰。

english.text: The five most famous swear words in Cantonese people ——diu、hai、gau、lan、cat

jyutping: gwong2 dung1 jan4 zeoi3 ceot1 meng2 ng5 go3 cou1 hau2 zi6——diu、hai、gau、lan、cat
text: 廣東人最出名五個粗口字——diu、hai、gau、lan、cat

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Don't worry, the directions are simple. Just drive two blocks, take a left, drive five blocks, take a right, drive two blocks, take another right, drive three blocks, take a right again, drive one block, take a left, drive three blocks, take a right, drive three blocks, take another right, drive a block, realize that you're exactly where you were before and that all this previous instruction was completely pointless, and drive one more block in that direction. Got that?

jyutping: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1，fong1 hoeng3 hou2 gaan2 daan1，zi2 jiu3 zaa1 loeng5 go3 gaai1 keoi1，hoeng3 zo2 haang4，haang4 ng5 go3 gaai1 keoi1，hoeng3 jau6 haang4，haang4 loeng5 go3 gaai1 keoi1，zoi3 hoeng3 jau6 haang4，haang4 saam1 go3 gaai1 keoi1，zoi3 hoeng3 jau6 haang4，haang4 jat1 go3 gaai1 keoi1，hoeng3 zo2 haang4，haang4 saam1 go3 gaai1 keoi1，hoeng3 jau6 haang4，haang4 saam1 go3 gaai1 keoi1，hoeng3 jau6 haang4，haang4 jat1 go3 gaai1 keoi1，ji3 sik1 dou3 nei5 zing3 zing3 zau6 hai6 nei5 zi1 cin4 ge3 dei6 fong1，ji4 so2 jau5 zi1 cin4 ge3 zi2 si6 dou1 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 ji3 ji6 gam2 haang4 go2 go3 fong1 hoeng3，jin4 hau6 haang4。
text: 唔使擔心，方向好簡單，只要揸兩個街區，向左行，行五個街區，向右行，行兩個街區，再向右行，行三個街區，再向右行，行一個街區，向左行，行三個街區，向右行，行三個街區，向右行，行一個街區，意識到你正正就係你之前嘅地方，而所有之前嘅指示都係完全冇意義噉行嗰個方向，然後行。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "I had an in to the Mafia at one point." "Oh yeah?" "Yeah, this guy Anto—" "I don't need to know his name. Why are you telling me his name?" "He told me when I got out of the service that there was a job for me if I wanted one." "You didn't take it?" "No, that sounded like way too much stress." "I probably would have done the same. I hope, anyway."

jyutping: 「ngo5 jau5 jat1 zan6 si4 jau5 tiu4 lou6 jap6 haak1 sau2 dong2。」「o2 hai6 me1？」「hai6 aa3，jau5 go3 giu3 Anto ge3 jan4——」「m4 sai2 gong2 keoi5 meng2。ngo5 m4 seoi1 jiu3 zi1 keoi5 meng2。nei5 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 gong2 keoi5 meng2 bei2 ngo5 teng1？」「ngo5 teoi3 ng5 go2 zan6，keoi5 waa6 jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 soeng2 zou6，keoi5 jau5 fan2 gung1 bei2 ngo5。」「nei5 mou5 zip3？」「mou5，teng1 lok6 aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6 laa3。」「ngo5 daai6 koi3 dou1 wui5 zou6 tung4 joeng6 syun2 zaak6。zi3 siu2 ngo5 hei1 mong6 zi6 gei2 wui5 gam3 zou6。」
text: 「我有一陣時有條路入黑手黨。」「哦係咩？」「係呀，有個叫 Anto 嘅人——」「唔使講佢名。我唔需要知佢名。你點解要講佢名畀我聽？」「我退伍嗰陣，佢話如果我想做，佢有份工畀我。」「你冇接？」「冇，聽落壓力太大喇。」「我大概都會做同樣選擇。至少我希望自己會咁做。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: As bees in early summer swarm apace / through flowery fields, when forth from dale and dell / they lead the full-grown offspring of the race, / or with the liquid honey store each cell, / and make the teeming hive with nectarous sweets to swell. / These ease the comers of their loads, those drive / the drones afar. The busy work each plies, / and sweet with thyme and honey smells the hive.

jyutping: zau6 hou2 ci5 co1 haa6 ge3 mat6 fung1 sing4 kwan4 fei1 ceot1，cyun1 so1 hai2 faa1 tin4 zi1 gaan1，cung4 saan1 guk1 tung4 kai1 gaan3 daai2 ceot1 sing4 nin4 ge3 hau6 doi6；waak6 ze2 zoeng1 jik6 taai3 fung1 mat6 cyu5 cyun4 hai2 mui5 jat1 go3 fung1 caau4 gaak3，ling6 mun5 jat6 ge3 fung1 caau4 cung1 mun5 tim4 mei5 faa1 mat6。jau5 di1 mat6 fung1 bong1 san1 loi4 ze2 se3 haa6 di1 fu6 ho6，jau5 di1 zoeng1 mou5 jung6 ge3 hung4 fung1 gon2 zau2。mui5 zek3 mat6 fung1 dou1 mong4 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 gung1 zok3，fung1 caau4 cung1 mun5 baak3 lei5 hoeng1 tung4 fung1 mat6 ge3 tim4 hoeng1。
text: 就好似初夏嘅蜜蜂成群飛出，穿梭喺花田之間，從山谷同溪澗帶出成年嘅後代；或者將液態蜂蜜儲存喺每一個蜂巢格，令滿溢嘅蜂巢充滿甜美花蜜。有啲蜜蜂幫新來者卸下啲負荷，有啲將冇用嘅雄蜂趕走。每隻蜜蜂都忙住自己嘅工作，蜂巢充滿百里香同蜂蜜嘅甜香。
